product_name: Jack Microphone Tie Clip-on Lapel Mikrofon Microfono Mic for Mobile Phone 3.5mm
description:
Summary

The 3.5mm Jack Tie Clip-on Lapel Microphone for Mobile Phone captures audio through a 360-degree omnidirectional polar pattern. This hardware uses a standard 1.5m cable to bridge the distance between the speaker and a smartphone. It provides a direct audio feed for mobile recording without requiring external battery power.
Key Features

    360-Degree Pickup:
    Omnidirectional pattern records sound from every angle. This maintains consistent volume even when the speaker turns their head away.
    3.5mm CTIA Connector:
    Gold-plated TRRS jack plugs into standard mobile headphone ports. It fits most smartphones without needing extra software or complex drivers.
    Integrated Lapel Clip:
    Metal spring-loaded clip secures the microphone to clothing. This enables hands-free operation during interviews or vlogging on the move.
    1.5 Meter Cable:
    Sufficient wire length for waist-to-collar positioning. It prevents cord tension and accidental disconnects while recording stationary or walking.
    -32dB Sensitivity:
    High-gain input picks up quiet speech clearly. This helps reduce the electronic hiss often heard in cheap clip on microphones in Bangladesh.

Frequently Asked Questions
How to connect 3.5mm lapel mic to phone?

Plug the 3.5mm jack directly into the smartphone's headphone port. Phones without a dedicated 3.5mm port require a standard USB-C or Lightning to 3.5mm adapter.
Which is the best cheap collar mic for vlogging?

This 3.5mm lapel microphone for mobile phone provides 360-degree pickup for consistent audio levels. It serves as a reliable entry-level option for recording speech in indoor environments.
